notes: Every spell is one LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA (or LoRA) applied video-to-video. 'cloud_ready' spells use LoRA files that ship in Comfy's own template library, so they run on Comfy Cloud with no import. The others need a local GPU (download the LoRA into models/loras) or a Comfy Cloud plan that allows LoRA import; set SPELLCLIP_EXTRA_LORAS to a comma list of spell ids once imported. Strengths follow the identity-first rule: as strong as the model card allows without warping faces or framing.

spells.name: Googly Eyes
spells.tagline: Everyone in frame gets googly eyes. Same face, same shot, suddenly ridiculous.
spells.negative: pc game, console game, video game, ugly, 3d render, photo, still, static, slow

spells.name: Go Vertical
spells.tagline: Landscape to a true 9:16 vertical. The model paints the missing top and bottom.
spells.negative: pc game, console game, video game, ugly, 3d render, photo, still, static, slow

spells.name: Erase Object
spells.tagline: Name the thing in the foreground and it disappears.
spells.negative: blurry, low resolution, ugly, garbled mess, compression artifacts, glitch, stop motion, still image, pixelated, robotic voice, oversaturated

spells.name: Clean Text
spells.tagline: Strip burned-in subtitles, captions and watermarks.
spells.prompt: Remove subtitles, captions, watermarks and related text occlusions from the video, restoring a clean and natural underlying image.
spells.negative: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly

spells.name: Restore
spells.tagline: Old, scratched, faded footage comes back sharp and modern.
spells.prompt: A modern, high-resolution video shot in vivid color, sharp detail, contemporary cinematography.
spells.negative: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly

spells.name: Add Water
spells.tagline: Rain, floods, surf or a waterfall, poured into your shot.
spells.prompt: Reference shows {scene}. Edited shows the same scene with water added. ADD WATER {water}. Subject identity, clothing, framing, and background geometry are identical to the reference; only water-related elements differ between reference and edited.
spells.negative: deformed water, morphing faces, inconsistent clothing, blurry, jittery, distorted, worst quality

variants.name: Downpour
variants.water: heavy rain pouring down through the frame, droplets splashing on every surface, wet reflective ground, mist in the air

variants.name: Flood
variants.water: murky flood water filling the ground, rising and partially submerging everything low in the frame, ripples spreading outward

variants.name: Ocean Surf
variants.water: foaming ocean surf rushing in across the ground, white spray splashing up, water pulling back between waves

variants.name: Waterfall
variants.water: a roaring waterfall cascading down behind the subject, spray and mist drifting through the frame

variants.name: Gentle Stream
variants.water: a shallow, clear stream flowing across the ground, rippling gently around the subject

spells.strength_note: Model card: 1.0 to 1.05 keeps identity safest, 1.1 to 1.5 replaces surfaces, 1.5+ warps faces. 1.1 is the hardest setting that stays identity-safe.

spells.name: Nightfall
spells.tagline: Turn broad daylight into night, same shot, same motion.
spells.prompt: {scene} at night, {light}. Only the lighting changes from day to night; identical composition, framing, camera movement and motion.
spells.negative: daytime, bright sunlight, blue sky, overexposed, worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

variants.name: Starry Night
variants.light: under a dark, star-filled sky with a faint Milky Way, cool moonlight and deep natural shadows

variants.name: Neon City
variants.light: lit by cool streetlights and colorful neon signs, wet reflections, deep shadows

variants.name: Warm Lamplight
variants.light: lit by warm amber tungsten light from one side, deep shadows, high contrast

spells.name: Vanish
spells.tagline: Remove every moving person from the shot and leave a clean, empty scene.
spells.prompt: An empty clean plate of the exact same location. {scene}. No people, no body parts, no moving subjects appear; the background, lighting and camera motion are identical to the reference.
spells.negative: people, person, body parts, hands, backpack, person shadows, ghosting, blur, jitter, distorted, worst quality

spells.name: Instant Shave
spells.tagline: Beard gone in one click. The face, the motion and the voice stay.
spells.prompt: REMOVEBEARD {scene}, completely smooth and clean-shaven, bare skin, no beard, no stubble, no facial hair.
spells.negative: beard, mustache, facial hair, stubble, worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

spells.name: Colorize
spells.tagline: Bring black and white footage into natural color.
spells.prompt: Reference shows a grayscale video of {scene}. Edited shows the same scene with natural colors restored. COLORIZE {scene}, natural lifelike colors, realistic skin tones and sky. Subject identity, framing, and background geometry match the reference; only color differs.
spells.negative: oversaturated, color bleed, blurry, jittery, distorted, worst quality
